errors.evidence: This is a 100% stacked bar chart, where all bars have the same total length representing 100%. It is the length of the colored segments within each bar that corresponds to a proportion, not the total length of the bar.
The horizontal axis is the value axis, representing percentages from 0% to 100%. The vertical axis is the category axis.
The categories are arranged on the vertical axis from top to bottom, not from bottom to top.
The vertical axis is the category axis, which lists the different behaviors. The value axis is the horizontal one.
